opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as a way to make money with Ethereum and directs viewers toward registration through a wallet, with the displayed structure requiring "ONLY 0.05 ETH TO JOIN" for its X3 and X4 arrangements. Its earnings model is tied to referrals after registration, while the speaker urges viewers to join and earn daily. The description further instructs prospective participants using Trust Wallet to have at least 0.075 Ethereum to accommodate charges. Although the presentation claims profits can be made without referrals and denies being a Ponzi scheme, those assertions do not resolve the depicted entry payment and referral-linked structure. Calling the platform safe and risk free is an assurance, not evidence that the payment-based recruitment model is harmless.
